business: David A. Miller, Attorney (NJ Realty Lawyer)
summary: Solo-practice New Jersey firm of David A. Miller, in practice over 30 years, concentrated on residential and commercial real-estate purchases, sales and refinances plus wills/estate planning, probate, LLC formation and small-business sales; the site says he also prepares income tax returns in tax season. Every customer-facing path is manual: the site offers only a phone number and an aol.com email, with no form, no scheduling, no click-to-call, and it tells callers to 'ask to speak with me'. The office is a third-floor suite at 77 Milltown Rd in East Brunswick, but the site footer and contact page still say 'Located in Manalapan, NJ', and the Google listing is unclaimed with 4 reviews averaging 3.0.

inferences.inference: Missed-call and after-hours lead loss is the most likely daily failure at the front door.
inferences.reasoning: The only channels are a landline and a personal aol.com address, the phone number sits in an unclickable image, no form or chat exists, and no hours or after-hours message is published anywhere on the site.

inferences.inference: Scheduling is done manually and closing dates override other appointments.
inferences.reasoning: The 1-star Google review quotes the office rescheduling twice because 'our primary business is real estate closing', and there is no calendar/scheduling tool on the site or in the page source.

inferences.inference: Client status updates during a closing are ad hoc rather than systematised.
inferences.reasoning: No client portal, status page or document system is visible; the owner says he explains the whole process at the first meeting, and one reviewer disputes whether papers were mailed at all.

inferences.inference: The Avvo profile is probably the same practitioner as the site owner, despite the different town and address.
inferences.reasoning: Name (David A./Alan Miller), Manalapan location matching the site's 'Located in Manalapan, NJ' line, 100% residential real-estate focus, and reviews referencing East Brunswick and a local RE/MAX agent. Flagged as probable, not confirmed.

inferences.inference: The 3.0 Google average is materially unmanaged rather than a true quality signal.
inferences.reasoning: Only 4 reviews exist, the oldest roughly eight years old, the listing is unclaimed ('Claim this business'), there are no owner responses and no photos, so a single 1-star review carries 25% weight.

inferences.inference: Tax-season work plus closings creates a predictable capacity crunch that would suit an intake/triage agent.
inferences.reasoning: The site states he personally prepares income tax returns in tax season while the bulk of the practice is real estate, with one attorney and a small clerical team.
